ServerLifecyclePhase.description:
Process-local lifecycle phase for a shared app-server daemon.

`Draining` means the server has begun a graceful restart and will reject new work admission while existing assistant turns drain. `Forced` means a second forceable shutdown signal arrived; the server may terminate before all work completes. Neither phase is a durable thread checkpoint.

description: Emitted when the process lifecycle phase or draining turn count changes.

daemonInstanceId.description: UUID generated for this app-server process. It changes after restart.

runningAssistantTurns.description: Number of assistant turns currently reported as running by this process.

transitionId.description: UUID shared by lifecycle updates for one graceful drain attempt. It is absent while the process is ready.

title: ServerLifecycleUpdatedNotification
